# PosBuzz Complete Product Architecture & Knowledge Graph

## About PosBuzz
PosBuzz is a cloud-native Point of Sale (POS) and Multi-Branch Management platform built for retailers, boutiques, cafes, supermarkets, and growing multi-store chains.

## Key System Pillars

### 1. Offline-First Point of Sale Engine
- Operates 100% uninterrupted during network/internet outages.
- Local indexed cache for catalog lookup, barcode scans, and tax calculations.
- Transactions are queued locally and automatically synced with background retry upon reconnection.
- Multi-tender payment options: Cash, Credit/Debit Cards, Bank Transfers, and Mobile Money / MFS (e.g., bKash, Nagad, Rocket, Upay).
- Cart features: Hold & recall multiple carts, item-level discounts, order-level promotions, and price type toggles (Retail vs Wholesale).

### 2. Multi-Branch & Centralized HQ Management
- Single master product catalog with branch-specific pricing and tax overrides.
- Inter-branch inventory transfer workflows with dispatch tracking and receiving confirmation.
- Chain-wide consolidated financial rollups, P&L statements, and top-selling SKU leaderboards.
- Granular Role-Based Access Control (RBAC): Admin, Store Manager, Accountant, Cashier.

### 3. Batch Expiry (FEFO) & Serial Number Tracking
- Batch-wise inventory management with purchase invoices, cost per unit, and expiry date alerts.
- Individual Serial Number tracking for high-value appliances and electronic warranty lookup.
- Audited inventory adjustments for damage, loss, shrinkage, and physical count reconciliation.

### 4. Quotations & Promotions
- Pro-forma quotation builder with 1-click conversion to finalized sales invoice.
- Time-bound branch promotional campaigns (percentage, flat, combo discounts).
- Customer credit ledger and partial payment tracking.

### 5. Hardware & Peripherals Compatibility
- Zero proprietary hardware lock-in.
- Supports ESC/POS 58mm and 80mm thermal receipt printers via USB, LAN/Ethernet, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and Serial COM.
- Direct web-to-printer bridging with automated cash drawer triggering.
- Compatible with all 1D/2D handheld and omnidirectional barcode scanners (Code128, EAN-13, QR).
- Electronic weighing scale integration (RS232/USB) with auto-tare calculations.

### 6. Customer Loyalty & Marketing Engine
- Configurable loyalty points accrual per currency spent.
- Tiered VIP member discounts.
- Digital receipts via SMS and Email.

### 7. Audit Security & End of Day (EOD) Closing
- Tamper-proof Blind EOD Cash Closing to eliminate cashier bias.
- Operational expense and petty cash tracking directly at the register.
- Real-time gross and net profit margin analytics.

## Pricing Plans
- **Starter**: $29/mo ($24/mo annual) - 1 location, 2 registers, 5,000 SKUs, offline POS, thermal printing.
- **Professional**: $79/mo ($64/mo annual) - Up to 5 branches, unlimited SKUs, stock transfers, batch/serials, customer loyalty, blind EOD audit.
- **Enterprise**: $199/mo ($169/mo annual) - Unlimited locations & registers, private cloud or on-premise container deployment, custom webhooks, 99.99% SLA.
